answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Every entry must show Harvestbound ferreter coppice seal before the ledger opens, because a seal ferreters renew after warren checks. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. Nobody is waved through free: a waiting period of 30 days that no payment can shorten is the price, and the nectar never covers it twice. The horizon is on the docket. One onyx, one entry.
